title: 第36章 人不行了
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 刘烨那双眼睛，就那么直直地盯着张国海。张国海被他看得心里发毛，气焰瞬间就灭了。他扭过头，对着墙，又开始哼哼唧唧。“我……”徐喜弟想说点什么，却发现嗓子眼堵得厉害。“你不用管。”刘烨打断她的话，然后转身对外面喊了一声，“二牛，大壮，进来搭把手！”李二牛和王大壮磨磨蹭蹭地进了院子，一看到张家这光景，脸上都写满了嫌弃。“怎么弄？”李二牛捏着鼻子问。“我背他。”刘烨指了指张国海的屋子，然后又对另外两人说，“你们两个，把永福弄出来。用门板抬。”张永福那屋，徐喜弟已经不敢再进去了。李二牛和王大壮对视一眼，一脸的不情愿，但大队长的话还在耳边，只能硬着头皮往里走。“他娘的，什么味儿！”“还活着没？”两人骂骂咧咧地进去，没一会儿，就架着软得像面条一样的张永福出来了。他脑袋耷拉着，眼睛闭着，嘴巴微微张开，要不是胸口还有那么一点点起伏，真跟个死人没两样。刘烨那边也很快，他直接走进屋，把还在床上叫唤的张国海往肩上一扛，就跟扛一袋米似的，轻松得很。“哎哟！我的腰！我的腰！你慢点！要断了！”张国海在刘烨背上杀猪一样地叫唤。刘烨充耳不闻，大步就往外走。李二牛他们找了块旧门板，把张永福放上去，一人抬一头。“喜弟，你想跟去？”临出门，发现徐喜弟跟在后面，刘烨停下脚步，回头问她。徐喜弟点点头，眼巴巴地看着他。家里两个人送去医院，总得有个亲属在旁吧？“在家待着。”刘烨的语气不容商量，“猪要喂，看好巴儿姐。我们天黑前赶回来。”说完，他不再看她，背着张国海就出了院子。李二牛和王大壮抬着门板跟在后面，嘴里还在嘀咕。“真是倒了八辈子血霉。”“晦气！”徐喜弟站在门口，看着他们一行人，浩浩荡荡地往村外走。刘烨高大的背影，像一座山，把所有风雨都挡在了外面。直到他们的身影消失在村口拐角，徐喜弟才缓缓转身，关上了院门。院子里一片狼藉，屋里，巴儿姐正拿着一根小木棍，在地上画圈圈。仿佛外面天塌下来，都跟她没关系。徐喜弟长长地吐出一口气，卷起袖子，走进火房。日子，还得过。有了刘烨，她感觉心里踏实了不少。……去镇上的路全是土路，坑坑洼洼。刘烨力气大，脚程快，背着一百多斤的张国海，愣是走在了最前面。张国海起初还一个劲地喊疼，后来被山路颠得七荤八素，也只剩下哼哼的力气了。后面抬着门板的李二牛和王大壮就惨了。张永福虽然不重，但门板沉，而且人是软的，一颠簸就往下滑，两人得时不时停下来调整。“他娘的，我看这小子都快断气了，还送个屁啊！”王大壮累得满头大汗，把门板一放，坐在地上直喘气。“歇会儿，歇会儿。”李二牛也累得够呛，“他就该烂在家里头，也省得咱们遭这罪。”刘烨回头看了一眼，眉头皱了皱，没说话，只是放慢了脚步等他们。一行人走走停停，总算在下午，赶到了镇上的卫生院。卫生院里一股浓浓的来苏水味，一个穿着白大褂、戴着眼镜的老医生从里屋走了出来，看到他们这阵仗，也吓了一跳。“怎么回事？”“医生，快给看看，摔着了！”刘烨把张国海小心地放在一张长凳上。李二牛和王大壮也把门板抬了进来，往地上一放。“这个……也看看，好像不行了。”老医生先是走到张国海跟前，在他腰上按了几下，眉头皱成了团。“哎哟！疼！疼死我了！”张国海叫得比谁都响。“怎么搞的？伤到腰椎，弄不好要瘫的！”老医生有些紧张起来，“我们这小卫生院，怕是治不好。”说完，他又看看一边更严重的张永福。走到门板前，蹲下身，先是探了探张永福的鼻息，又翻开他的眼皮看了看，最后伸手摸向他的后颈。所有人都屏住了呼吸。老医生摸了很久，脸上的表情越来越凝重。他站起身，摇了摇头。“医生，他……他还有救吗？”刘烨忍不住问。老医生看了他一眼，又看了看另外两个村民，最后叹了口气。“准备后事吧。”一句话，像块石头砸进水里。李二牛和王大壮都愣住了。“啥？死了？”“不是吧……来的时候还好好的……”“没死。”老医生说，“但跟死了也差不多了。”他顿了顿，似乎在组织语言。“颈椎断了。看样子，不是今天断的，至少有三天了吧。”“什么？”刘烨脑子嗡的一声。“不可能！”张国海还没反应过来医生说自己腰的事，听到儿子断了脖子，就大叫起来。“他前几天就是从床上掉下去了，怎么可能断脖子？”“从床上掉下去？”老医生像是听到了什么不可思议的事情，“怎么掉的？能把颈椎摔断？”这个问题，没人能回答。“他这情况，按理说，当时就该瘫了，连气都喘不了。能撑到现在，是个奇迹。”老医生又补充了一句，“就算是大医院的洋大夫来了，也救不活了。现在就是一口气吊着，随时都可能……唉。”屋子里一片死寂。李二牛和王大壮面面相觑，脸上说不清是震惊还是别的什么。忙活大半天，背来一个快死的人。刘烨站在原地，也惊得起了一身的鸡皮疙瘩。一个几天前就要死的人，硬生生挺了几天，把徐喜弟打了，才咽气。一股寒意从他脚底板升起。“那……那现在怎么办？”李二牛结结巴巴地问。“要么，现在就抬回去，等着。要么，就在这儿，也等着。”老医生只能无奈地交代。张国海彻底傻了，嘴巴张着，半天没合上。他儿子，要死了？
content_en: Liu Ye's eyes were staring straight at Zhang Guohai.Zhang Guohai was so upset when he saw him that his arrogance was instantly extinguished.He turned his head, faced the wall, and started humming again."I..." Xu Xidi wanted to say something, but found that his throat was severely blocked."Don't worry about it." Liu Ye interrupted her, then turned around and shouted outside, "Er Niu, Dazhuang, come in and help!" Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang entered the yard slowly. When they saw the scene of the Zhang family, their faces were full of disgust."How?" Li Erniu asked, pinching his nose."I'll carry him." Liu Ye pointed to Zhang Guohai's house, and then said to the other two people, "You two, get Yongfu out. Use the door panel to lift him." Xu Xidi no longer dared to enter Zhang Yongfu's house.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang looked at each other with reluctance on their faces, but the captain's words were still in their ears, so they could only walk in bravely."Damn, what does it smell like!" "Are you alive?" The two of them went in cursing, and after a while, they came out with Zhang Yongfu who was as soft as noodles.His head was drooped, his eyes were closed, and his mouth was slightly open. If his chest hadn't been heaving a little, he would have looked like a dead person.Liu Ye was also very quick. He walked directly into the room and lifted Zhang Guohai, who was still shouting in bed, onto his shoulders, just like carrying a bag of rice, very easily."Ouch! My waist! My waist! Slow down! It's about to break!" Zhang Guohai screamed on Liu Ye's back like a pig.Liu Ye turned a deaf ear and strode out.Li Erniu and the others found an old door panel, put Zhang Yongfu on it, and each of them lifted one end."Xidi, do you want to follow?" Before going out, he found Xu Xidi following behind. Liu Ye stopped and turned around to ask her.Xu Xidi nodded and looked at him eagerly.If two members of the family are sent to the hospital, there must be a relative by their side, right?"Stay at home." Liu Ye's tone was non-negotiable, "If you want to feed the pigs, keep an eye on Sister Ba'er. We'll get back before dark." After saying that, he stopped looking at her and carried Zhang Guohai on his back out of the yard.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang carried the door panel and followed behind, still muttering."It's really bad luck for eight lifetimes." "Bad luck!" Xu Xidi stood at the door and watched the group of them walking out of the village.Liu Ye's tall back was like a mountain, blocking out all the wind and rain.It wasn't until their figures disappeared around the corner of the village that Xu Xidi slowly turned around and closed the courtyard door.The yard was in a mess. Inside the house, Sister Baer was holding a small wooden stick and drawing circles on the ground.It seemed like the sky was falling outside and it had nothing to do with her.Xu Xidi let out a long breath, rolled up his sleeves, and walked into the fire room.Days have to go on.With Liu Ye, she felt a lot more at ease.…The road to town is all dirt and full of potholes.Liu Ye was very strong and fast on his feet. Carrying more than 100 kilograms of Zhang Guohai on his back, he was stunned to walk in front.Zhang Guohai kept screaming in pain at first, but later he was shaken by the mountain road, and he only had the strength to hum.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang, who were carrying the door panel behind them, were miserable.Although Zhang Yongfu is not heavy, the door panel is heavy and soft, so it will slide down when it bumps, so the two of them have to stop and adjust from time to time."Damn it, I think this kid is about to die, what a fart!" Wang Dazhuang was so tired that he was sweating profusely. He lowered the door panel and sat on the ground panting."Have a rest, have a rest." Li Erniu was also very tired, "He should die at home, so that we don't have to suffer this." Liu Ye looked back, frowned, said nothing, and just slowed down to wait for them.The group of people walked around and finally arrived at the health center in the town in the afternoon.There was a strong smell of Lysol in the health center. An old doctor wearing a white coat and glasses came out of the back room and was shocked when he saw their fight."What's going on?" "Doctor, look at him quickly, he fell!" Liu Ye carefully placed Zhang Guohai on a bench.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang also carried the door panel in and put it on the ground."Let's take a look at this. It seems like it's not working anymore." The old doctor first walked up to Zhang Guohai, pressed his waist a few times, and frowned."Ouch! It hurts! It hurts me so much!" Zhang Guohai screamed louder than anyone else."What happened? You injured your lumbar vertebrae and may be paralyzed!" The old doctor became a little nervous. "I'm afraid we can't cure it in this small health center." After saying that, he looked at Zhang Yongfu, who was in a more serious condition.Walking to the door panel, he squatted down, first felt Zhang Yongfu's breath, then opened his eyelids to take a look, and finally reached out to touch the back of his neck.Everyone held their breath.The old doctor touched it for a long time, and the expression on his face became more and more solemn.He stood up and shook his head."Doctor, he...can he still be saved?" Liu Ye couldn't help but ask.The old doctor looked at him, then at the other two villagers, and finally sighed."Get ready for the funeral." One sentence was like a stone thrown into the water.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang were both stunned."What? Dead?" "No... he was still fine when he came..." "Not dead." The old doctor said, "But it's almost as good as dead." He paused and seemed to be organizing his words."The cervical vertebra is broken. It seems that it was not broken today, but at least three days ago." "What?" Liu Ye's head buzzed."Impossible!" Before Zhang Guohai could realize what the doctor said about his waist, he screamed when he heard that his son had broken his neck."He fell out of bed a few days ago. How could he break his neck?" "Falled out of bed?" The old doctor seemed to have heard something incredible. "How did he fall? Can he break his cervical spine?" No one could answer this question."In his case, it stands to reason that he should have been paralyzed at that time and couldn't even breathe. It's a miracle that he can survive until now." The old doctor added, "Even if a foreign doctor from a big hospital comes, he can't save him. He is hanging in a sling now, and he may be...sigh at any time." There was a dead silence in the room.Li Erniu and Wang Dazhuang looked at each other. It was unclear whether they were shocked or something else.After working for a long time, a man who was about to die came on his back.Liu Ye stood there with goosebumps all over his body.A man who was about to die a few days ago managed to hold on for several days and beat Xu Xidi before he died.A chill rose from the soles of his feet."Then... what should we do now?" Li Erniu asked stammering."Either, carry it back now and wait. Or, just stay here and wait." The old doctor could only explain helplessly.Zhang Guohai was completely stunned, his mouth was open and he didn't close it for a long time.His son is dying?
